The step of the figure, 160 by 100 pixels, from 60 to 180, with a fine pattern of steps of 3 between -6 and 6 everywhere. The texture deviation is the standard deviation in columns 10 to 39, far from the edge. The edge means average the 3 columns on each side of the edge, where the input means are about 60 and 180. Values past 0 or 255 are clipped. The other settings are the defaults: r = 16 and eps = 0.01 for the guided base, sigma_s = 16 and sigma_r = 25.5 for the bilateral one.
